subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned user facts be a first-party Control UI memory feature now, folded into broader memory-file editing, or deferred until Control UI plugin contribution slots define the panel seam?
rationale: The request changes persistent context and sensitive user-data behavior, while current main only supports raw allowlisted file editing and related items do not choose the storage, freshness, injection, or security contract.

options.title: Keep canonical pinned-facts design
options.body: Use this issue to settle pinned-fact storage, always-injected versus last-seen semantics, diff-preview behavior, and security before implementation.

options.title: Fold into memory panel
options.body: Treat the first version as part of a broader MEMORY.md/USER.md memory panel if maintainers want raw memory editing to own the UX.

options.title: Defer to plugin panel seam
options.body: Wait for the Control UI contribution-slot direction if maintainers want memory/context panels to be plugin-contributed rather than bespoke core UI.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical pinned-facts design
recommendation.body: Use this issue to settle pinned-fact storage, always-injected versus last-seen semantics, diff-preview behavior, and security before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses current Control UI, gateway API, and security-sensitive memory behavior, and current source history points to steipete on the present paths.
